question: How should other meditations be approached by this same direction?
premises: Other meditations should be resorted to.
They reach the burden of unexcelled means.
inference: By this same direction, other meditations are resorted to and reach unexcelled means without sequence.
uncertainties: anayaiva diśānyāni may be read as one compound or phrase.
plain_english: By this same direction, other meditations too should be resorted to, those that reach the burden of the unexcelled means without sequence.
